## Definitions

- [statement] The Composer package mongodb/mongodb is a high-level PHP library layered over the mongodb extension. It provides client, database, and collection abstractions plus CRUD and common-command helpers. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-php-library · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, PHP library (mongodb/mongodb) versus the mongodb PECL extension · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-php-driver, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/php-library/current/

## Structure and components

- [statement] The upgrade guide states that library and extension patch versions are not synchronized and provides separate update commands for each component. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/php-library/current/references/upgrade.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, PHP library (mongodb/mongodb) versus the mongodb PECL extension
- [statement] A custom `Codec` implements `encode()`, `decode()`, and `getEncoderClass()`; the codec registry must contain a codec for the Scala type being encoded or decoded. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/scala/scala-driver/current/data-formats/codecs.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Scala driver Observables and case-class codecs

## How it works

- [statement] Single-document writes are atomic. Use a multi-document transaction when several document writes must be applied or discarded together. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/transactions.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions · also: https://laravel-news.com/mongodb-transactions-in-laravel
- [statement] Referenced associations are not autosaved by default when saving their parent; enable `autosave` when required. Embedded documents are saved within the parent, and nested-attributes associations automatically gain autosave behavior. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/data-modeling/associations/customize-association.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries
- [statement] Mongoid coerces query values to a declared field’s type when constructing a query. Wrap a value in `Mongoid::RawValue` to bypass this coercion. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/interact-data/specify-query.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries
- [statement] A collection query can filter embedded fields using dot notation, but it returns top-level model instances even when every condition references embedded fields. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/interact-data/specify-query.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/data-modeling/associations/embedded-associations.md
- [statement] When Composer reports that the mongodb extension is missing despite it appearing in another PHP environment, check which PHP binary Composer uses and which configuration the CLI and web runtime load. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-php-driver/issues/874 · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, PHP library (mongodb/mongodb) versus the mongodb PECL extension · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/php-library/current/get-started.md
- [statement] When an installed extension is unavailable at runtime, check the PHP runtime and its configuration: multiple PHP versions have separate extension-install commands, and CLI and web environments can load different php.ini files. (high confidence) — https://www.php.net/manual/en/mongodb.installation.php · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, PHP library (mongodb/mongodb) versus the mongodb PECL extension · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/php-library/current/get-started.md
- [statement] Coinbase reported in June 2020 that its Ruby processes each maintained a MongoDB pool shared by that process’s threads, and that blue-green deployment overlap increased the database connection count. This is a historical production example of connection multiplication across processes and deployment replicas. (low confidence) — https://www.coinbase.com/blog/scaling-connections-with-ruby-and-mongodb · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Ruby driver CRUD and connection management
- [statement] Construct a Mongo::Client with a MongoDB connection URI; most applications can reuse a single client across multiple requests because it owns connection pools. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/ruby-driver/current/connect/mongoclient.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Ruby driver CRUD and connection management · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/ruby-driver/current/connect/connection-pools.md
- [statement] Call client.close when finished, or construct the client with a Ruby block so it closes automatically when the block finishes. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/ruby-driver/current/connect/mongoclient.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Ruby driver CRUD and connection management
- [statement] Coinbase reported in its June 18, 2020 case study that per-process Ruby pools and overlapping blue-green deployments multiplied MongoDB connections. It introduced a connection proxy after finding many connections mostly unused; this is historical workload evidence, not a general requirement to deploy a proxy. (low confidence) — https://www.coinbase.com/blog/scaling-connections-with-ruby-and-mongodb · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Ruby driver CRUD and connection management
- [statement] A `CodecRegistry` is immutable. Compose custom codecs or providers with the default registry, placing custom codecs first when overriding defaults. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/languages/scala/scala-driver/current/data-formats/codecs.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Scala driver Observables and case-class codecs

## How-to and procedures

- [statement] Use `DB::table()` to select a MongoDB collection, chain constraints, and finish with `get()` or `first()`. Select a named MongoDB connection with `DB::connection()` when MongoDB is not the default connection. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/query-builder.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions
- [statement] Configure attribute conversions with `$casts`; the documented model example casts a BSON date field to Laravel `datetime`. Allow-list mass-assignable fields with `$fillable`, or exclude fields with `$guarded`. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/model-data/model-class.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions
- [statement] Install the library with composer require mongodb/mongodb and separately install and enable the mongodb extension; the library requires that extension. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-php-library · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, PHP library (mongodb/mongodb) versus the mongodb PECL extension · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/php-library/current/get-started.md
- [statement] Use insert_one for a single document and insert_many for a list of documents. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/ruby-driver/current/crud/insert.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Ruby driver CRUD and connection management
- [statement] Use delete_one to remove the first matching document and delete_many to remove all matching documents; both accept a query filter. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/ruby-driver/current/crud/delete.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Ruby driver CRUD and connection management · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/ruby-driver/current/crud/bulk-write.md
- [statement] Use insert_one for a single document and insert_many for a list of documents. If the application does not supply _id, the driver can generate unique BSON::ObjectId values; duplicate _id values violate the unique index. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/ruby-driver/current/crud/insert.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Ruby driver CRUD and connection management
- [statement] Use update_one for the first matching document and update_many for all matches, supplying a query filter and an update document such as a $set operation. Set upsert: true to insert when no document matches. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/ruby-driver/current/crud/update.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Ruby driver CRUD and connection management

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] Issue #2720 reports that Laravel MongoDB 4.1 raised `Transaction already in progress` when `firstOrCreate()` attempted creation inside an existing transaction. A maintainer attributed the error to an attempted nested transaction and described replacing that implementation with an atomic operation. This is historical issue evidence, not verification of current installed behavior. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/laravel-mongodb/issues/2720 · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions
- [statement] Composer platform requirements describe the PHP environment and its extensions as virtual packages. Requiring a platform package installs no code; it cannot substitute for installing the native mongodb extension required by the PHP library. (high confidence) — https://getcomposer.org/doc/articles/composer-platform-dependencies.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, PHP library (mongodb/mongodb) versus the mongodb PECL extension · also: https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-php-library
- [statement] Ordered bulk writes stop after a write-operation failure. With ordered: false, the driver attempts all specified operations and reports write errors after those attempts; execution order is not guaranteed. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/ruby-driver/current/crud/bulk-write.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Ruby driver CRUD and connection management · also: https://p-mongo.github.io/rendered-docs/driver/tutorial/reference/bulk-operations.html
- [statement] Iterate query results with each to consume a cursor that holds a subset of results in memory; chained limit and sort options refine the query results. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/ruby-driver/current/crud/query/find.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Ruby driver CRUD and connection management
- [statement] Update results distinguish matched_count from modified_count: an identical document is excluded from modified_count. Check acknowledged? before reading other result methods; an unacknowledged result cannot provide those values. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/ruby-driver/current/crud/update.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Ruby driver CRUD and connection management
- [statement] Collection#bulk_write accepts a list of operation hashes, including insert_one, update_one, update_many, replace_one, delete_one and delete_many. Ordered execution stops after a write error; ordered: false attempts the remaining operations without guaranteeing execution order. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/ruby-driver/current/crud/bulk-write.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Ruby driver CRUD and connection management
- [statement] A pool limit is not a deployment-wide connection limit: the Ruby pool guide also describes monitoring connections outside the application pool, and Coinbase documented separate pools for Ruby processes, shared by their threads. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/ruby-driver/current/connect/connection-pools.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Ruby driver CRUD and connection management · also: https://www.coinbase.com/blog/scaling-connections-with-ruby-and-mongodb
- [statement] Scala migration guidance says the Scala 3 compiler cannot expand Scala 2.13 macros. Using `-Xignore-scala2-macros` permits type checking but macro calls throw at runtime; use a library version published for Scala 3. (low confidence) — https://docs.scala-lang.org/scala3/guides/migration/macros.html · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Scala driver Observables and case-class codecs

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Set query-level options through `options()`. MongoDB recommends using the dedicated query-builder methods for result modifiers such as skip, sort and limit rather than passing these modifiers as options. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/query-builder.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions
- [statement] Callbacks customize model lifecycle events and can be implemented on top-level and embedded documents. The docs recommend testing callback chains and using callbacks for cross-cutting concerns rather than core domain logic. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/data-modeling/callbacks.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries
- [statement] The server-selection guide describes filtering read candidates by read preference, applying the localThresholdMS latency window, and selecting randomly among remaining candidates. For writes it starts with writable servers rather than read-preference matches. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/ruby-driver/current/connect/server-selection.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Ruby driver CRUD and connection management
- [statement] The pool guide conflicts with the connection-options reference and client source on max_idle_time units: its detailed example calls 10000 milliseconds ten seconds, whereas the reference maps max_idle_time: 10 to maxIdleTimeMS=10000 and the client source documents seconds. Treat the pool-guide example as conflicting documentation rather than a safe Ruby configuration to copy. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/ruby-driver/current/connect/connection-pools.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Ruby driver CRUD and connection management · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/ruby-driver/current/connect/connection-options.md, https://github.com/mongodb/mongo-ruby-driver/blob/master/lib/mongo/client.rb

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Laravel MongoDB extends Laravel’s Eloquent and query-builder APIs to operate on MongoDB data. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/query-builder.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions · also: https://github.com/mongodb/laravel-mongodb

- [statement] Models use the snake-case plural class name as the default collection; override `$table` to choose another collection. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/model-data/model-class.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions
- [statement] A MongoDB Eloquent model can use the `Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\SoftDeletes` trait: deleting marks the document with `deleted_at`, and normal retrieval automatically excludes deleted documents. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/model-data/model-class.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions · also: https://oneuptime.com/blog/post/2026-03-31-mongodb-laravel-eloquent-style-queries-with-laravel-mongodb/view
- [statement] The query-builder documentation says results are `stdClass` objects starting in Laravel MongoDB v5.0. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/query-builder.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions
- [statement] The integration exposes MongoDB `_id` through the `id` alias; query-builder find results present `_id` as `id`, so separate fields with both names are incompatible with that conversion. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/model-data/model-class.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/query-builder.md
- [statement] Laravel MongoDB supports explicit transaction control with `DB::beginTransaction()`, `DB::commit()`, and `DB::rollback()` before commit. Rollback reverts writes performed in the transaction. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/transactions.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions · also: https://laravel.com/docs/12.x/database
- [statement] Standalone MongoDB deployments do not support these transactions. The Laravel MongoDB transaction guide prescribes a replica set or sharded cluster, rejects nested transactions with a `RuntimeException`, and disallows parallel operations inside a single transaction. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/transactions.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions
- [statement] The transaction guide states that Laravel MongoDB does not support `Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\DatabaseTransactions` or `Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\RefreshDatabase`; it suggests `Illuminate\Foundation\Testing\DatabaseMigrations` to reset the database after each test. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/transactions.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions
- [statement] Issue #2720 reported `firstOrCreate()` failing inside a transaction on Laravel MongoDB 4.1 with “Transaction already in progress”; the 4.2 release announcement says the issue was fixed by implementing `Model::createOrFirst()` with atomic `findOneAndUpdate`. (high confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/laravel-mongodb/issues/2720 · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions · also: https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/laravel-mongodb-4-2-released-with-laravel-11-support/271635
- [statement] Laravel MongoDB provides MongoDB-backed Eloquent models and a fluent query builder; Laravel documents the integration as the mongodb/laravel-mongodb package maintained by MongoDB. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/model-data/model-class.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/query-builder.md, https://laravel.com/docs/12.x/database
- [statement] Define a MongoDB Eloquent model by extending `MongoDB\Laravel\Eloquent\Model`. The default collection name is the snake case plural of the model class name; override `$table` to choose another collection. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/model-data/model-class.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions
- [statement] MongoDB stores the primary key in `_id`; the Laravel integration exposes it as `$id` on a model and translates query-builder `id` references to `_id`. The model can customize the identifier type with `$keyType`. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/model-data/model-class.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions
- [statement] The query builder supports filtering nested fields with dotted paths, sorting with `orderBy()`, and skipping results with `skip()`; `whereRaw()` accepts MongoDB Query API filters. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/drivers/php/laravel-mongodb/current/interact-data/query-builder.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Laravel MongoDB: Eloquent models, query builder and transactions
- [statement] A persistent Mongoid model includes `Mongoid::Document`; typed fields can be declared with `field :name, type: String`. Instances can be stored in a collection or embedded in other documents. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/data-modeling/documents.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries
- [statement] Embedded associations use `embeds_one` or `embeds_many` on the parent and `embedded_in` on the child. The child is stored inside the parent; multiple children are stored as an array field. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/data-modeling/associations/embedded-associations.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/data-modeling/documents.md
- [statement] Referenced associations support `has_one`, `has_many`, `belongs_to`, and `has_and_belongs_to_many`. By default, `belongs_to` stores the parent’s `_id` in the child document. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/data-modeling/associations/referenced-associations.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries
- [statement] Association callbacks `before_add`, `after_add`, `before_remove`, and `after_remove` apply to `embeds_many`, `has_many`, and `has_and_belongs_to_many`. Register them as association options and pass the added or removed document to the callback. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/data-modeling/callbacks.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries
- [statement] Deletion paths have different callback semantics: document `delete` skips callbacks while `destroy` runs them; for embedded associations, `clear` and `delete_all` skip destroy callbacks while `destroy_all` runs them. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/interact-data/crud.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/data-modeling/associations/embedded-associations.md
- [statement] Mongoid query methods return chainable, lazily evaluated `Mongoid::Criteria` objects. Iterating results executes the query; chaining query methods merges filter criteria. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/interact-data/specify-query.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries
- [statement] Embedded matching filters associations already loaded in the application without querying the server. Its supported operators are narrower than server queries: text, geospatial, JavaScript execution, `$expr`, and `$jsonSchema` are not implemented. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/data-modeling/associations/embedded-associations.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries
- [statement] A historical embedded-assignment performance investigation attributed increasing Ruby-side work to `object_already_related?`; Alex Bevilacqua profiled the issue without a database connection. This supports profiling association construction separately from database operations, not an unconditional claim that current releases retain the defect. (medium confidence) — https://jira.mongodb.org/browse/MONGOID-4889 · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries · also: https://alexbevi.com/blog/2022/09/09/performance-profiling-a-mongoid-issue-using-appprofiler/
- [statement] A persistent Mongoid model includes `Mongoid::Document`; model instances can live in a collection or be embedded, and saving converts them to BSON. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/data-modeling/documents.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries
- [statement] Referenced associations support `has_one`, `has_many`, `belongs_to`, and `has_and_belongs_to_many`. By default a belongs-to child stores the parent identifier; many-to-many associations store arrays of associated identifiers on both sides unless the inverse is disabled. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/data-modeling/associations/referenced-associations.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries
- [statement] Query filters support Ruby field hashes, Query API operator hashes, and symbol operators. For fields declared in the model, Mongoid coerces filter values to the field type; `Mongoid::RawValue` bypasses that coercion. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/mongoid/current/interact-data/specify-query.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Mongoid ODM: documents, associations, callbacks and queries
- [statement] `elem_match` requires at least one array element to satisfy all supplied conditions and supports embedded associations. It does not join referenced associations; cross-collection querying needs an aggregation pipeline or separate queries. - [statement] Mongoid provides document lifecycle callbacks for top-level and embedded models. Association callbacks `before_add`, `after_add`, `before_remove`, and `after_remove` are configured on `embeds_many`, `has_many`, or `has_and_belongs_to_many` and receive the affected document. - [statement] Each Mongo::Client has a connection pool for each server in the topology. Connections are reused, and without a configured min_pool_size, pools open connections on demand. - [statement] The shared connection-pooling specification requires thread-safe pool behavior but explicitly declares connections and pools not fork-safe; its reset-after-fork procedure clears pools and closes connections in the child. This is a specification requirement, not verification of a particular Ruby release’s fork hooks. (low confidence) — https://github.com/mongodb/specifications/blob/master/source/connection-monitoring-and-pooling/connection-monitoring-and-pooling.md · keywords: MongoDB PHP library and Laravel MongoDB, the Ruby driver and Mongoid, and the Scala driver, Ruby driver CRUD and connection management
- [statement] Each Mongo::Client maintains a pool per topology server. Pool capacity and concurrent connection creation are separate controls: max_pool_size limits pool size and max_connecting limits parallel connection establishment. - [statement] The Ruby connection-options reference expresses connect_timeout and server_selection_timeout in seconds, while the corresponding URI options are connectTimeoutMS and serverSelectionTimeoutMS in milliseconds. The reference describes timeout_ms as an operation timeout in milliseconds.
